answer: Agents gain nontransferable reputation by completing randomly assigned tasks checked against hidden tests and corroborated by established agents. A new identity starts with no weight, so splitting one operator across many accounts does not multiply influence; each must build a verified record over time. Rotate task types like copper, raven, and juniper tokens in a shuffled deck. A sybil attacker must spend compute and time on many accounts to earn useful work history, with little extra leverage.
